sql: select o.strategy, o.market_ticker, o.quantity, o.status, o.created_at, sum(f.quantity) filled, avg(f.price) px from live_orders o left join fills f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id where o.market_ticker in (select distinct o2.market_ticker from live_orders o2 join fills f2 on f2.kalshi_order_id=o2.kalshi_order_id where o2.strategy='Jmmsell10') and o.action='buy' and o.strategy<>'Jmmsell10' group by 1,2,3,4,5 having sum(f.quantity)>0 order by 2
